help.openadapt:
Usage: openadapt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Record, compile and run workflows with OpenAdapt.

  Compile a demonstrated workflow into deterministic local replay. Healthy runs make no model calls;
  configured checks can halt on ambiguity. Native and remote substrates use platform-specific extras
  and permissions; training/evaluation commands are research.

  Quick Start (uv fetches Python 3.12 if needed):
      uvx --python 3.12 openadapt@latest quickstart
  Or, on Python 3.11-3.12:
      python -m pip install --upgrade openadapt
      openadapt quickstart

  Manual Demo Lifecycle:
      openadapt flow demo-record --out rec
      openadapt compile rec --out bundle --name demo
      openadapt flow lint bundle
      openadapt flow certify bundle --policy permissive
      openadapt flow replay bundle --demo-app

  Lint lists the demo's coverage gaps. The demo has warnings, so `lint --strict` exits 1 on it. The
  manual demo is runnable but not certified for consequential work. Use `openadapt flow tutorial`
  for the effect-verified first run.

  Give an MCP client your compiled workflows:
      openadapt agent serve --bundles DIR --mode production

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  demo      Try the demonstration and tutorial
  verify    Check effects, receipts, and evidence
  record    Record a task and its narration
  teach     Teach a correction to a stopped workflow
  compile   Compile and prepare workflow bundles
  run       Run, resume, and route workflows
  approve   Review and approve paused work
  undo      Declare and run approved undo steps
  qualify   Qualify a workflow for its intended use
  repair    Review, test, and promote repairs
  inspect   Inspect workflows, runs, and reports
  workflow  Manage reusable workflow libraries
  services  Run local services and connectors
  setup     Configure connections, privacy, and access
  research  Run benchmarks and research tools
  wrap      Run an agent task once, then reuse its checked compiled tool
  test      Test an agent on real apps with planted faults, for CI

help.openadapt setup:
Usage: openadapt setup [OPTIONS]

  Add OpenAdapt to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

  For each one installed, register the OpenAdapt MCP server and install a skill that tells the agent
  how to turn an app task into a tool it can call again. By default the agent teaches read-only
  tasks in web apps. With --app and --verify it teaches saves in that one app, on the web, the
  desktop, or over RDP or Citrix. Prints every change. Running it again changes nothing that is
  already set up.

Options:
  --dry-run                       List what setup would change, and change nothing.
  --undo                          Reverse what earlier setup runs changed.
  --client [claude|cursor|codex|gemini]
                                  Set up only this client (repeat for more). Default: every one
                                  found.
  --app FILE                      deploy.yaml naming one app (web, desktop, RDP or Citrix). The
                                  agent then teaches saves in that app, each read back with
                                  --verify.
  --verify FILE                   With --app: the verify.yaml that reads the app's system of record.
  --authorization FILE            With --app: a person's signed teach authorization (openadapt-flow
                                  teach-authorization). Without one, nothing the agent teaches is
                                  admitted.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

  Also available as: setup clients Operations: clients, connect, deploy, doctor, version

help.openadapt test:
Usage: openadapt test [OPTIONS]

  Test an agent on real apps with planted faults, for CI.

  Runs any agent against stateful scenarios on an app in local containers (OpenEMR, Dolibarr,
  EspoCRM), plants faults on its saves, grades the app's database, and gates against a stored
  baseline. Every argument passes to openadapt_flow.agent_test unchanged.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

help.openadapt verify:
Usage: openadapt verify [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Verify writes against the system of record, for any agent.

  Around each write your agent makes, it gets a verified receipt or a refusal, never an unverified
  success. Python agents use the SDK (`from openadapt.verify import ...`); any MCP client uses
  `openadapt verify serve`.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  draft   Draft a write contract with a model; admit it only if OpenAdapt qualifies it on a...
  ledger  Writes whose outcome isn't known yet, held so they aren't sent twice.
  serve   Serve verify_contracts, verify_begin, verify_check and verify_recheck over MCP (stdio).
help.openadapt verify draft:
Usage: openadapt verify draft [OPTIONS]

  Draft a write contract with a model; admit it only if OpenAdapt qualifies it on a sandbox.

  `openadapt verify draft --describe openapi.json --trace demo.har --task task.yaml --sandbox
  sandbox.yaml --out DIR`. The model (key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) works at setup only; an admitted
  contract runs with no model calls. `--help` lists every option.
help.openadapt verify ledger:
Usage: openadapt verify ledger [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Writes whose outcome isn't known yet, held so they aren't sent twice.

  Every verified write goes through the ledger. A write that may have landed, or was refuted, is
  held: no worker sends it again until a read-back resolves it (`reconcile`) or a person checks the
  record (`release`). The ledger holds no record values.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list       Show held and open writes: key, state, when it began, outcome.
  reconcile  Read held writes back and resolve the ones the store now settles.
  release    Release a held write after a person checked the record.
help.openadapt verify ledger list:
Usage: openadapt verify ledger list [OPTIONS]

  Show held and open writes: key, state, when it began, outcome.

  Also each provisional CONFIRMED whose recheck is still owed, with its due time, so a recheck isn't
  lost when the server that holds it restarts.

Options:
  --ledger DIRECTORY  Ledger folder (must match the configured protected journal, if set).
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.openadapt verify ledger reconcile:
Usage: openadapt verify ledger reconcile [OPTIONS] [KEY]

  Read held writes back and resolve the ones the store now settles.

Options:
  --contracts DIRECTORY  Folder of write contracts (<name>.yaml) the writes were made under.
                         [required]
  --ledger DIRECTORY     Ledger folder (must match the configured protected journal, if set).
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.openadapt verify ledger release:
Usage: openadapt verify ledger release [OPTIONS] KEY

  Release a held write after a person checked the record.

Options:
  --by TEXT                Who checked the record.  [required]
  --reason TEXT            What they found.  [required]
  --found [absent|landed]  absent: the write isn't in the store, so it may be sent again. landed: it
                           is, so it is never sent again.  [required]
  --ledger DIRECTORY       Ledger folder (must match the configured protected journal, if set).
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
help.openadapt verify serve:
Usage: openadapt verify serve [OPTIONS]

  Serve verify_contracts, verify_begin, verify_check and verify_recheck over MCP (stdio).

Options:
  --contracts DIRECTORY  Folder of write contracts (<name>.yaml, openadapt.verify/v1).  [required]
  --state DIRECTORY      Where baselines and receipts go (default ~/.openadapt/verify).
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
